You are redesigning the Zip Code Checker storefront widget. The user wants:
1. Edge-to-edge design (no card box with shadow - remove the container box entirely, widget flows naturally into the page)
2. 2-3 style presets that merchants can pick from in the admin
3. Very high-converting CRO design - clean, modern, branded

Read the current liquid file first:
/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid

And the admin widget config:
/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.widget.tsx (lines 1-260 and 700-850)
/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/prisma/schema.prisma

Then implement the following:

## Design Decision: 3 Style Presets

Add a `widgetStyle` field to WidgetConfig with these options:

### Style 1: "minimal" (DEFAULT - edge to edge, no card)
- NO card/box/shadow - widget sits directly on the page background
- Slim search bar with pill shape (border-radius: 50px)
- Input and button in a unified pill container
- Subtle border #e5e7eb, 2px
- On focus: border turns primary color with glow
- Result appears as a thin pill/badge below, no box
- Very clean, Apple-style

### Style 2: "bold" (Full-width branded strip)  
- Full-width background strip using primaryColor at 6% opacity
- Left accent border (4px solid primaryColor)  
- Wide, confident layout
- Button is full pill shape
- Result shows as inline badge with icon
- Feels like a product guarantee section

### Style 3: "card" (Elevated card - current look but improved)
- Keep the card with shadow but make it much better
- Gradient background (very subtle, almost white)
- Bigger, bolder heading
- Search bar with focus glow
- Results with left-accent color strip

## Implementation Plan:

### Step 1: Add widgetStyle to Prisma schema
Add `widgetStyle String @default("minimal")` to WidgetConfig model

### Step 2: Update liquid file
- Add `widgetStyle` to defaults in `renderWidget(cfg)`
- Rewrite `injectCss(wid, cfg, rad)` to switch CSS based on `cfg.widgetStyle`
- Create three distinct CSS blocks for each style
- All 3 styles keep: heading with pin icon, unified search bar, result with icons

### Step 3: Update admin app.widget.tsx  
- Add widgetStyle to WidgetConfig type
- Add widgetStyle state + handler
- Add style selector UI (3 cards with visual preview of each style - like a thumbnail picker)
- Add `widgetStyle` to form data / reset defaults
- Update `buildWidgetCss()` to mirror all 3 style variants
- Update `WidgetPreview` component to switch between styles

### Step 4: Update api.widget-config.tsx to include widgetStyle in response

Then run: npm run typecheck

## CSS for Each Style

### "minimal" style CSS:
```
container: no background, no border, no shadow, padding: 0
heading: 18px, font-weight:800, margin-bottom:16px, display flex with pin icon
search bar: display:flex, border:2px solid #e5e7eb, border-radius:50px, overflow:hidden, transition
input: flex:1, padding:14px 20px, border:none, outline:none, background:transparent, font-size:15px
btn: background:primaryColor, color:#fff, border:none, padding:14px 28px, border-radius:50px, font-weight:700, font-size:15px
result (ok): display:flex, align-items:center, gap:10px, margin-top:14px, padding:12px 16px, background:successColor+"10", border-radius:50px (pill shape), font-size:14px, color:successColor, font-weight:500
result (fail): same but errorColor
result icon: small circle with check/x
```

### "bold" style CSS:
```
container: background:primaryColor+"08", border-left:4px solid primaryColor, padding:20px 24px, no border-radius (or 4px), width:100%
heading: 17px, font-weight:700
search bar: display:flex, background:#fff, border:1.5px solid #e5e7eb, border-radius:8px, overflow:hidden
input: flex:1, padding:12px 16px, border:none, outline:none, font-size:14px
btn: background:primaryColor, color:#fff, border:none, padding:12px 24px, font-weight:700, border-radius:0 8px 8px 0 (attached to right)
result: inline strip below search bar, padding:10px 14px, border-radius:6px, gradient background
```

### "card" style CSS (improved from current):
```
container: background:white, border-radius:12px, padding:24px, box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05)
heading: 18px, font-weight:800, letter-spacing:-0.02em
search bar: unified bar with 2px border, border-radius:10px
btn: border-radius:8px (square-ish, not pill)
result: gradient card with left accent
```

## Key Implementation Notes:

In the liquid file, the CSS injection currently does this:
```js
function injectCss(wid, cfg, rad) {
  var W = "#" + wid;
  var css = ... (all the CSS)
  var styleEl = document.createElement("style");
  styleEl.textContent = css;
  document.head.appendChild(styleEl);
}
```

Change it to call a style-specific function:
```js
function injectCss(wid, cfg, rad) {
  var style = cfg.widgetStyle || "minimal";
  var css = style === "bold" ? buildBoldCss(wid, cfg, rad) :
            style === "card" ? buildCardCss(wid, cfg, rad) :
            buildMinimalCss(wid, cfg, rad);
  css += scopeCustomCss(cfg.customCss, wid);
  var styleEl = document.createElement("style");
  styleEl.textContent = css;
  document.head.appendChild(styleEl);
}
```

For the admin style picker in app.widget.tsx, add a section above the colors section with 3 clickable style cards showing a tiny visual preview of each style, using inline styles. The selected one should have a ring/border highlight.

IMPORTANT: 
- Always run `npm run typecheck` at the end and fix all TypeScript errors
- The prisma migration needs to be created: `npx prisma migrate dev --name add-widget-style`
- After migration, run `npm run typecheck` again
- Do NOT create any migration if it involves breaking changes - just add the field
- The WidgetConfig in the admin has DEFAULTS defined around line 230 - add `widgetStyle: "minimal"` there
- The action handler around line 140 needs to save `widgetStyle: String(formData.get("widgetStyle") || "minimal")`
- The loader returns the config from DB - it will automatically include widgetStyle after schema update
- The api.widget-config.tsx returns the config - check it includes all fields
